tools.name: read_product
tools.description: Free, no key. Turns a product link (IKEA, any furniture shop) or the pasted text of a product page into real dimensions: name, width_mm, depth_mm, height_mm, price, link. Call it as soon as the user gives a furniture link. On success pass name, width_mm, depth_mm, height_mm, price and link unchanged

tools.name: create_room
tools.description: Free, no key. Creates a new plan at scale 1:50 and returns its project id plus purchase_url. Send name, plus either width_m and depth_m (rectangle) or rectangles (L-shape, alcove, bay), never both. Always send openings in this same call; without openings the checker treats the room as having no door

tools.name: place_furniture
tools.description: Places furniture and returns the checked plan as an image plus placed, rejected, issues and image_prompt. Send exactly one of spots, placement, or wish. Prefer spots: you name each piece and a rough position (at), the server finds the exact spot, snaps to a 5 cm grid and avoids walls, doors and othe

tools.name: set_door
tools.description: Replaces the full openings list of a project you created (an empty list removes all). Windows have no hinge. Until openings exist, door-swing clearance is not checked. Saved layouts may get new issues afterwards; run check_plan. Needs key; not available on beispiel-wohnzimmer.

tools.name: show_catalog
tools.description: Free, no key. Lists every piece Roomproof knows: catalog id (ASCII slug, copy it exactly), display name, width_mm, depth_mm, group. Call it with no group first. Custom pieces (name plus width_mm and depth_mm, e.g. from read_product) do not need the catalog.

tools.name: move_furniture
tools.description: Moves, rotates or removes one piece in the saved layout and returns the re-checked plan as an image with issues. Send x and y together (piece center, meters), rot, or remove true. The result is saved even with issues, so read them and move again if needed. Needs key on your own project, free on beis

tools.name: show_plan
tools.description: Returns the saved plan as an image drawn to scale, plus image_prompt and image_positions. For a photo of the room copy image_prompt verbatim into your own image generator; Roomproof does not render photos. Needs key on your own project, free on beispiel-wohnzimmer.

tools.name: check_plan
tools.description: Re-checks the saved layout only: pieces sticking out, overlaps, blocked areas including door swings, and a 0.9 m path to every piece. Does not place, move or spend a wish. Call it after move_furniture or when issues are unclear; ok true with an empty issues list is the condition for open_plan. Needs

tools.name: open_plan
tools.description: Call only after the last check_plan returned no issues. Returns view_url (read-only, to share) and edit_url (for the owner, with the scaled PDF download). Needs key; not available on beispiel-wohnzimmer.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "create_room" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Free, no key. Creates a new plan at scale 1:50 and returns its project id plus purchase_url. Send name, plus either width_m and depth_m (rectangle) or rectangle…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: set_door, move_furniture, check_plan, open_plan · Public sink: create_room, place_furniture, move_furniture, open_plan · Destructive: set_door, move_furniture.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: set_door, move_furniture, check_plan, open_plan · Public sink: create_room, place_furniture, move_furniture, open_plan · Destructive: set_door, move_furniture

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
